readings: For each film rating, calculate its average film `length`, ignoring missing lengths. Keep ratings whose average exceeds the average `length` across all films with nonmissing lengths. From those ratings, keep only ratings whose average exceeds the unweighted mean of the rating averages that passed the first cut. Return one row containing: the unweighted mean of the remaining ratings’ average lengths; the average amount by which those remaining rating averages exceed the average across all films; and the average amount by which they exceed the unweighted mean of the rating averages that passed the first cut. Do not round.

For each film rating, calculate its average film `length`, ignoring missing lengths. Keep ratings whose average exceeds the unweighted mean of all ratings’ average lengths. From those ratings, keep only ratings whose average exceeds the unweighted mean of the rating averages that passed the first cut. Return one row containing: the unweighted mean of the remaining ratings’ average lengths; the average amount by which those remaining rating averages exceed the unweighted mean of all ratings’ average lengths; and the average amount by which they exceed the unweighted mean of the rating averages that passed the first cut. Do not round.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
first_cut AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length
  FROM rating_averages AS ra
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE ra.avg_length > oa.avg_length
),
first_cut_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length
  FROM first_cut
)
SELECT
  AVG(fc.avg_length) AS mean_remaining_rating_averages,
  AVG(fc.avg_length - oa.avg_length) AS mean_excess_overall,
  AVG(fc.avg_length - fca.avg_length) AS mean_excess_first_cut
FROM first_cut AS fc
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN first_cut_average AS fca
WHERE fc.avg_length > fca.avg_length;

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
all_ratings_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length
  FROM rating_averages
),
first_cut AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length
  FROM rating_averages AS ra
  CROSS JOIN all_ratings_mean AS am
  WHERE ra.avg_length > am.mean_length
),
first_cut_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length
  FROM first_cut
)
SELECT
  AVG(fc.avg_length) AS mean_remaining_length,
  AVG(fc.avg_length - am.mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_all,
  AVG(fc.avg_length - fm.mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_first_cut
FROM first_cut AS fc
CROSS JOIN all_ratings_mean AS am
CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean AS fm
WHERE fc.avg_length > fm.mean_length
